xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex1122023-07-1715-14-27" ana="corpusmd:blo_rigs" status="reviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">bdag</rs> gis ni 'di ltar rig go || shes pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste | yang dag par rtogs pa dang | ma rtogs pa dang | log par rtogs pa dang | the tsoM mo || de la dang po ni tha snyad pa'i yang dag par rtogs pa kho na yin bas tshad ma'o || gnyis pa ni tha snyad pa'i rtogs pa'i byed pa dang bral ba yin bas snang <choice><corr>la</corr><sic>pa</sic></choice> ma nges pa dang bcad pa'i yul can no || gsuM pa ni myed pa'i don rtogs par <lb n="5a2"/> byed pa la log pa'i shes pa mtha' dag go || bzhi ba ni gang yang rnaM par myi gcod pas gang yang yongs su myi gcod pa'i phyir don <choice><corr>'jug</corr><sic>'jig</sic></choice>  pa'i nus pa myed pa'o || yid dpyod mtha' dag ni log pa'i shes par 'du ste | don myed par 'byung pas don myed pa'i rang bzhin dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro || dper na du ba dang dus mnyaM du yod pa'i dngos po rnaMs ni me myed kyang 'byung pas mye'i 'bras bu ma yin ba'i rang bzhin dang ma bral <lb n="5a3"/> ba bzhin no ||</seg></TEI>
